name: Pu Songling
contribution: A Chinese writer during the Qing dynasty, best known as the author of Strange Tales from a Chinese Studio.

checks.lead: Pu Songling (Chinese: 蒲松齡, 5 June 1640 – 25 February 1715) was a Chinese writer during the Qing dynasty, best known as the author of Strange Tales from a Chinese Studio (Liaozhai zhiyi).
checks.photo: no death year in or after 1860
